DOP: pakopa m. [ S. prakopa], agitation, disturbance; anger, fury; Nidd I 239, 24 (yo cittassa āghāto … kopo ~o … kodho …) = Dhs 1060 = Vibh 86, 19 ; Vism 235, 9 (svāyaṃ tesaṃ pi kimikulānaṃ ~ena maraṇaṃ nigacchati yeva); Ps II 227, 24 ([āpodhātu] pakuppatī ti oghavasena vaḍḍhati samuddato vā udakaṃ uttarati, ayaṃ assā pākatiko ~o); Sadd 487, 8 (kopo ~o); — ifc see kāya-, citta- ( sv citta 1 ), vacī-.
